description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureQueueAdapterFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing Azure Queue stream adapters within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It defines methods for initializing the factory, creating adapters and caches, and handling delivery failures.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Azure Queue stream adapters, managing adapter lifecycle, queue mapping, and failure handling.

methods.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with configuration options, data adapter, and logger factory.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting default failure handler if not provided.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AzureQueueAdapter instance wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used by the adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used for queue distribution.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns the task representing a delivery failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of AzureQueueAdapterFactory using dependency injection.
